summary.intent: Execute Phase 21 gap closure plans (21-08 through 21-11) for BYO IPFS node support, then run code quality cleanup and security review on all Phase 21 changes.
summary.outcome: All 4 gap closure plans executed and verified (human-approved), code simplified with 9 fixes applied, 2 high-severity security vulnerabilities fixed (SSRF blocklist gaps + DNS rebinding TOCTOU), all changes committed and merged with origin/main.

repo: Phase 21 work lives on branch `docs/phase-21-context` in the cipher-box-phase-20 working directory
PinningConfig type was not exported from @cipherbox/sdk — needed to add it to packages/sdk/src/index.ts
ByoIpfsConfig.protocol in packages/core/src/vault/types.ts only had 'psa' | 'kubo', missing 'pinata' — Pinata configs could not round-trip through that type
The localStorage key 'cipherbox-byo-ipns-name' was defined as a constant BYO_IPNS_NAME_KEY in StorageTab.tsx but referenced as a magic string in useAuth.ts
MigrationProcessor does raw fetch to TEE worker instead of using the existing TeeService abstraction
migration.service.ts used .find() to load all PinnedCid rows just to call .length — should use .count()
authTokenString() was decoded per-CID inside migration batch loops instead of once per batch
The TEE connection-test route lacks probePinata(), so server-side connection tests cannot auto-detect Pinata endpoints
MigrationStatus type union is independently defined in 3 places (entity, DTO as bare string, and web client) — comment in web client notes it will be replaced after api:generate
failedCidList in migration entity uses an unbounded comma-separated TEXT column with split/join on every update
After rebuilding @cipherbox/core package, TypeScript errors in web app cleared — type changes don't propagate without rebuild

code.finding: Private IP range checks were duplicated verbatim in validateEndpointUrl (hostname check) and validateResolvedIp (IP check). Fixed by extracting isPrivateAddress() helper. Also missing: 0.0.0.0, IPv6 unspecified (::), fc00::/7, 100.64.0.0/10 CGN range, and IPv4-mapped IPv6 normalization.

DNS resolution for SSRF validation was separate from the actual fetch — classic DNS rebinding TOCTOU. Fixed by adding ssrfSafeFetch() that resolves DNS once, validates the IP, and makes the request to the resolved IP with redirect: 'error'.
Local formatBytes function duplicated the existing export from apps/web/src/utils/format.ts used throughout file browser components.
checkQuota() called isUserByo() then getQuota() which also called isUserByo() — two identical DB queries per upload for non-BYO users. Fixed by querying usage directly.

setInterval polling started on mount unconditionally — fired network requests every 5s even when no migration existed. Also called setMigration on every poll even when status fields were identical, causing unnecessary re-renders.

authTokenString() called separately in fetchFromProvider, pinToProvider, and unpinFromProvider — up to 3N TextDecoder allocations per batch for the same bytes. Fixed by decoding once per migrateBatch call.

ByoIpfsConfig.externalProvider.protocol typed as 'psa' | 'kubo' while ExternalProviderConfig in sdk-core had 'psa' | 'kubo' | 'pinata'. Pinata configs stored via StorageTab would lose the protocol field.
probeKubo/probePsa logic duplicated near-verbatim from packages/sdk-core/src/pinning/connection-test.ts — only difference is TEE version omits CORS detection. Not fixed (architecture change scope).

workflow: GSD /simplify spawns 3 parallel review agents (reuse, quality, efficiency) — each reads the full diff independently and returns findings to aggregate
The classifyHandoffIfNeeded Claude Code runtime bug fires in the agent completion handler after all work is done — spot-check SUMMARY.md + git commits to confirm success before treating as failure
After /simplify and /security:review, changes are NOT auto-committed — must manually commit before attempting git pull --rebase or the rebase will fail with unstaged changes error
IPv6 hostnames returned by new URL().hostname include brackets (e.g. [::1]) — must strip brackets before IP validation checks
Core package type changes require a rebuild before downstream TypeScript compilation picks them up — pnpm -F @cipherbox/core build

friction: User's Pinata JWT had a leading 'b' typo (beyJ instead of eyJ) requiring re-entry
GitHub port 443 connection timed out multiple times during git fetch/pull operations
git pull --rebase failed with 'You have unstaged changes' because /simplify and /security:review edits were not committed — caused confusion about what was uncommitted and why
git pull --merge was attempted but is not a valid git option
IPv6 bracket handling was not accounted for in initial SSRF isPrivateAddress() implementation, causing test failures that required a follow-up fix
open_items: probe logic (probeKubo/probePsa) is duplicated between browser sdk-core and TEE connection-test route — needs shared extraction but is an architecture change
DualPinProvider.pin() runs secondary pin sequentially after primary — could use Promise.allSettled() for concurrent uploads, deferred as behavior change
BYO config load/decrypt logic duplicated in useAuth.ts and StorageTab.tsx — extracting shared loadByoConfigFromIpns() was deferred due to auth flow risk
MigrationProcessor should use TeeService instead of raw fetch() with manual auth headers — deferred to separate PR
MigrationStatus type union defined independently in 3 places — will be resolved when api:generate is run and generated types replace hand-written frontend type
failedCidList uses unbounded comma-separated TEXT column with split/join on every update — should use JSON column or junction table
TEE connection-test missing probePinata() — server-side connection tests cannot auto-detect Pinata endpoints
Migration endpoints have no rate limiting (MEDIUM security finding) — not addressed
ECIES decryption in TEE /migrate endpoint happens per-batch call with no session caching — 100 redundant decryptions for 1000 CIDs at BATCH_SIZE=10
8 TODO integration tests in tee-worker/src/__tests__/ssrf-validation.test.ts not yet implemented
deriveByoConfigIpnsKeypair in packages/crypto/src/vault/derive-ipns.ts is structurally identical to two sibling functions — could be refactored into a private helper, pre-existing pattern
